title: Protocol Error
description: Transport-level protocol error body for non-2xx REST responses. Distinct from error_response.json, which is the business-outcome envelope used on HTTP 200/201 when no resource can be returned. Protocol-error bodies are optional; when present they use this shape (`code`, `content`, and optional `continue_url`).

code.description: Protocol error code identifying the transport-level failure (for example profile_unreachable, version_unsupported, invalid_profile_url).

content.description: Human-readable description of the protocol failure.

continue_url.description: URL for buyer handoff or session recovery when discovery or negotiation fails.

examples.content: Unable to fetch agent profile: connection timeout
Protocol version 2026-01-12 is not supported. This business supports versions 2026-01-11 and 2026-01-23.
